verdict.rationale: Speech is Cheap is an API-only product, so it runs headlessly by design. Jobs are created by URL or file upload, then polled or delivered via webhooks and SSE ([speech-is-cheap-docs-2], [speech-is-cheap-docs-3], [speech-is-cheap-docs-7], [speech-is-cheap-docs-9]). The docs explicitly recommend a dedicated, revocable API key for each script or pipeline, and the upload command reads the key from the `SIC_API_KEY` environment variable, both of which suit CI. Health and auth-test endpoints, an OpenAPI spec, and a versioning policy with six months' deprecation notice support stable unattended pipelines. missing for 10: an official CLI or documented CI recipe (e.g. a GitHub Actions example), independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
